en.title: A complete bail agency website, front desk to back office
en.summary: Everything a family needs at 2 a.m. — the cost, the jails, starting bail, e-signing and paying online — and the court dates, check-ins and CRM the office needs the morning after. In English and Spanish.
en.challenge: A family calling at 2 a.m. wants three things fast: what it costs, whether you cover their jail and whether they can trust you. The office then has to collect signatures, payments and check-ins and make sure nobody misses court — usually by phone, paper and spreadsheet.
en.solution: One site that does both jobs. Families see the premium and a payment plan before they call, find their jail on a live map, pick an agent, start the bail and e-sign online, and pay by card, wallet, Zelle or Cash App. Defendants check in weekly and get court reminders by text. A 24/7 assistant answers in English and Spanish, and staff work from a CRM with every bond, court date and payment on one screen. Shown with Ellison & Reyes, a demo agency — every page, form and screen works.

en.title: One system for the whole bail agency
en.summary: An agency portal and agent app for US bail bond companies — bonds, court dates, check-ins, e-signature and payments in one place.
en.challenge: Most bail agencies still run on paper files, a shared inbox and a spreadsheet of court dates. One missed hearing can cost the full bond.
en.solution: A portal for the office and an app for agents. Every bond, defendant and cosigner lives on one record; court-date reminders and check-ins go out by text in English and Spanish; cosigners sign and pay the premium from their phone. In development — shown here with a fictional agency.

en.title: A WhatsApp CRM that turns conversations into sales
en.summary: One shared inbox for the whole team, with an AI assistant, a sales pipeline, automations and broadcasts — all built around WhatsApp.
en.challenge: More than two billion people use WhatsApp, and plenty of businesses sell on it. But one phone, several staff and no record of who said what means leads go cold, customers wait, and nobody can see the pipeline.
en.solution: A complete business platform built around the company’s WhatsApp line. The team works every conversation from one shared inbox. An AI assistant answers from the company’s own knowledge base, qualifies the lead and hands it to a person at the right moment. Contacts, tags, deals and tasks live in one CRM; trigger-based automations route new leads and send follow-ups; broadcasts go out in bulk with delivery and read tracking; and a dashboard shows management what is happening today. The screens shown use a demo workspace, not a customer’s data.
